packageRules.description: Keep Python on the version Ubuntu 26.04 ships in the container image

Hold the .NET runtime on the major version VintageStory targets. VintagestoryServer.runtimeconfig.json (1.22.x) requests Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.0.0 with the default rollForward (Minor), so a .NET 11 runtime refuses to start it. Raise this when VintageStory's runtimeconfig tfm moves to net11.0; check with: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/data/server:/s:ro" mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/runtime:<tag> dotnet /s/VintagestoryServer.dll --version
